decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed change of use from garage to habitable room would be compatible with the character and appearance of the property, would not harm the living conditions of the adjoining occupiers, and would comply with the Council's parking standards. The development therefore complies with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing for Developments) and the Residential Extensions Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the proposed external alterations to the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the habitable room is used).

Condition : 5 - The existing windows formed in the eastern elevation of the extension shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other openings shall be formed in any wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The habitable room hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the single-family dwelling known as 40A King's Avenue Hounslow. The building shall not be used for any commercial use or as a separate residential unit.
description: Conversion of garage to habitable room.
